messages:
morgan (eng): Hit a weird onboarding glitch with ephemeral keys — sampleapp keeps using the org-scoped key instead of the project one. Anyone seen this?
alex (sdk): Can you paste minimal repro?
morgan (eng): Yep — super tiny: create ephemeral via CLI, export REDWOOD_API_KEY, run sampleapp with --project. It logs that it's using org key.
morgan (eng): Repro steps:
```bash
rw keys create --ephemeral --project myproj > ephem.json
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(jq -r .token ephem.json)
./sampleapp --project myproj
# sampleapp output: Using API key scope org:acme (falling back)
```
alex (sdk): Hmm. Does the token have a project prefix? We detect scope by token prefix currently (proj_ vs org_). Ephemeral tokens are `ephemeral_...` so they don't indicate project.
tess (devex): So SDK is sniffing token and prioritizing that over explicit flags/env? That seems risky.
devon (cli): @alex yeah CLI used to prefer token-sniffing to avoid extra envs. But we added --project later and didn't update precedence.
alex (sdk): I can see the code: SDK checks env REDWOOD_API_KEY -> parsePrefix -> if org return org client else project. It only consults REDWOOD_PROJECT if token parsing fails.
morgan (eng): That explains it. Ephemeral lacks prefix so parsePrefix returns fallback org because org is default in our tenant.
tess (devex): UX-wise we should honor explicit CLI arg > REDWOOD_PROJECT env > REDWOOD_API_KEY parsing. User intent is explicit.
devon (cli): Agreed. I'll open a small patch to rearrange precedence in CLI glue. Quick fix: set REDWOOD_PROJECT env to myproj or pass --project and unset REDWOOD_API_KEY.
morgan (eng): Workaround: export REDWOOD_PROJECT=myproj then run. That works.
alex (sdk): Proposed SDK fix: if token prefix is ephemeral_* treat as 'unknown' not org, and check REDWOOD_PROJECT next. Also add explicit env REDWOOD_PROJECT_OVERRIDE to force project selection.
tess (devex): Could we add a warning in onboarding guide about ephemeral tokens not encoding scope?
devon (cli): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/pull/424 (reorders precedence + docs). CI failure? @ci-bot any tests broken?
ci-bot: Build passed — all unit tests green. :white_check_mark:
alex (sdk): I'll add a small patch in SDK to treat ephemeral_ prefix as ambiguous and prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT env. Also add unit test for rotation streams that use ephemeral tokens.
morgan (eng): Thanks — will validate once SDK release cut. I'm running into this during a quick customer demo so a patch today would be ideal.
tess (devex): Could we also include a tiny note in sampleapp logs when using token-sniffing fallback like: `WARNING: using inferred org scope; to force project set REDWOOD_PROJECT`?
devon (cli): Good idea. I'll add that log line in CLI shim.
morgan (eng): For now my quick workaround is: `unset REDWOOD_API_KEY && rw auth login --project myproj` then export the returned token.
alex (sdk): Thanks all. I'll follow up w/ PR link.
morgan (eng): :thumbsup:
